subject: Net vs Gross invoicing for Vertex.ai — VAT ID & reverse-charge split
messages:
From: Mara Thompson <billing@vertex.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: VAT treatment for June invoice (PO 45321)

Hi Jonas —

We received the June billing notice tied to PO 45321. Our AP team needs confirmation of how Redwood wants to handle VAT for this period. Two quick questions:

1) Will Vertex be billed gross (with VAT charged) or net under the reverse-charge mechanism?
2) If reverse-charge, can you confirm the Redwood EU VAT ID that we should record? Without a validated VAT ID our finance team will not authorize net payment.

Can you also confirm whether Redwood will issue a single invoice or split line items (platform fee vs managed services) for different tax treatments?

Attaching the PO for reference (Vertex_PO_45321.pdf).

Thanks,
Mara Thompson
AP Manager, Vertex.ai
attachments: Vertex_PO_45321.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mara Thompson <billing@vertex.ai>
Cc: finance@vertex.ai
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: VAT treatment for June invoice (PO 45321)

Hi Mara —

Thanks for the PO and the clear questions. Short answers first:
- We can apply reverse-charge (net) for B2B supplies into the EU if you provide a validated EU VAT ID.
- If you cannot provide a valid VAT ID, we will issue a gross invoice that includes VAT and you can reclaim per your local rules.

About splitting: we typically prefer a single invoice that lists the line items, but we can emit split invoices if your AP system requires separate tax treatments per line (platform usage vs professional services). Please advise which you prefer.

I've attached our VAT certificate for your records (redwood-vat-cert.pdf). If you send your EU VAT number I can run the VIES check and confirm the result.

Next steps:
- If Vertex provides VAT ID by EOD we will reissue a net invoice (reverse-charge) and flag the existing invoice as reissued.
- If not, we will proceed with a gross invoice.

Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Ops
Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood-vat-cert.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: VAT treatment for June invoice (PO 45321) — decision request

FYI — forwarding Vertex's note and my reply. Need quick guidance from finance/legal on whether we should:

A) Wait for Vertex VAT ID and reissue a net invoice (reverse-charge) — requires VIES validation and HubSpot update.
B) Issue gross invoice now and let Vertex reclaim VAT later — avoids delay in our collections but may annoy the buyer.
C) Issue split invoices: one net (services) + one gross (platform) if that reduces friction.

Context: DEAL-78934 is in contract stage with monthly usage billing. Vertex indicated their AP team will block payment until VAT ID is validated. Payment hold risks a 30-day delay.

Quoted below is the external thread for context.

On Mon, 1 Jun 2026 at 09:12, Mara Thompson <billing@vertex.ai> wrote:
> We received the June billing notice tied to PO 45321. Our AP team needs confirmation of how Redwood wants to handle VAT for this period...

Jonas

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 3 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: VAT treatment for June invoice (PO 45321) — decision request

Jonas —

Finance preference is 1) validate VAT ID before switching to net and 2) do not issue split invoices unless the customer specifically requests them — split docs complicate recognition and our AR matching. Key points:

- Validation: We must run the VIES check and save the screenshot/record. A negative or unverifiable VIES result means we should issue gross.
- Timing: If Vertex confirms they'll provide the VAT ID within 48 hours, we can wait and reissue without escalating. Beyond that, we should issue the gross invoice to keep cashflow moving and mark as eligible for reissuance if/when the ID is validated.
- Collections: Put a 14-day payment hold flag in HubSpot (see link) so AE/CS can coordinate collection outreach.

Suggested workflow:
1) Ask Vertex for their VAT ID and confirm they'll provide VIES screenshot (or we will run VIES).
2) If provided within 48 hours, run VIES, reissue net invoice, and update the invoice reference with "reissued following VAT validation".
3) If not provided, issue gross invoice and log an AP follow-up task to revisit after 30 days.

I don't recommend split invoices unless their AP system cannot reconcile combined invoices.

Lauren Bishop
VP, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
